content.json:
# NexGen Cloud Compliance Dashboard
Real-time policy compliance across all subscriptions and management groups.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| extend complianceState = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| summarize count() by complianceState
| render piechart
content.title: Overall Compliance State

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.complianceState == 'NonCompliant'
| project PolicyName = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionName), Resource = tostring(properties.resourceId), State = properties.complianceState
| take 50
content.title: Top Non-Compliant Resources

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| summarize Compliant = countif(properties.complianceState == 'Compliant'), NonCompliant = countif(properties.complianceState == 'NonCompliant') by PolicyName = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionName)
| extend ComplianceRate = round(todouble(Compliant) / (Compliant + NonCompliant) * 100, 2)
| project PolicyName, ComplianceRate, Compliant, NonCompliant
| order by ComplianceRate asc
content.title: Compliance Rate by Policy
